items.title: MAS bans four former insurance representatives over misconduct
items.grounded_note: Singapore's Monetary Authority imposed prohibition orders of four to 10 years on four former representatives of AXA Insurance, Manulife Financial Advisers and DBS Bank following convictions involving cheating, forgery or computer-related offences. The action signals continued enforcement scrutiny over intermediary conduct.

The sovereign-backed pool materially expands domestic capacity amid Middle East conflict and disrupted shipping routes.

items.grounded_note: Chan San San moved from CEO of Prudential Singapore to the newly created role of Chief Partnership Officer at Eastspring Investments effective 28 September 2026. items.grounded_note: AIA Singapore announced benefit and premium revisions for HealthShield Gold Max plans and riders, applying to new purchases and policy renewals from 1 October 2026.
